title: MC Unbalanced World
description: A great overhaul to survival progression, adds 30+ hours of content, to enjoy alone or with friends
body:
Ever wanted to upgrade your survival Minecraft Experience in a more adventure focused style?

Dive into the Unbalanced World...
     * 30 plus hours of gameplay
     * More than 11 new weapons and armor sets
     * 6 New Bosses
     * New dungeons and structures
     * Reworks and so much more...
     
TRAILER:
https://youtu.be/7usu27Kzdzs

IMPORTANT FILES: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12N4STg-Qyq7q7_jxrHrJYyeoo-js5e0K?usp=drive_link


Welcome Player

Thank you for downloading Unbalanced World, follow the instructions below for the setup:

1) Download the "Unbalanced World Resource Pack", as the name states, it is the resource pack made for the experience

2) Download the "overworld" file, this is the actual datapack and all of the content will be within it

3) OPTIONAL, Download the "soundtrack" file, this contains ambient and combat tracks separate to Boss themes

4) Finally it is recommended to play in a New World for the full experience 

The Unbalanced World does require a somewhat beefy computer or performance enhancing mods like Optifine and Sodium to run at decent TPS

Please take into account this is still just a datapack and comes with its downsides.

Thank you for understanding and enjoy a fresh survival experience with 30+ Hours of progression
